what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3302 Ukrainian refugees in the United States, 0.1% of all refugees from Ukraine.
Germany hosts the most Ukrainian refugees, followed by Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022, and an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2001 to 2006, come before those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 7 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 43607, at the end of 2006, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
